{{Top|leg}}
The '''suma''' was a flower-producing [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The suma plant relied on [[pom-hopper]]s to spread its seeds. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] ground its petals into a dye that could be used to write secret messages. This dye was either invisible or the same [[Color/Legends|color]] of the parchment on which it was written.
